content:
A **moth** is a creature in *Fallout 76*.

Moths are mentioned in the Pioneer Scout Camp Terminal Entries as an answer to one of the questions on the Entomologist exam. [1] They made a physical appearance debut during the May 2024 Mothman Equinox with the Fluttering Moths item, and then again in August 2024 in taxidermy form. The species mentioned include the Virginia Creeper Moth, American Dagger Moth, Beautiful Wood Nymph Moth, Io Moth and Luna Moth. 

All of the moths included as taxidermies are based on real world species of the same names.

Moths are mentioned in *Fallout 76*.
